text_block_list.text: Zenno Rob Roy came to a halt in front of a VR fantasy action game.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
N-No, um... I just got curious
about that catchphrase over there...
choice_data_list: "The Ultimate VR Experience! Your Very Own Heroic Tale!"...

text_block_list.text: I see. This seems like a worldview Zenno Rob Roy would love. It might be good for a change of pace.
choice_data_list: Sounds fun... Want to play together?
Sounds like fun... Want to play together?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
A-Are you sure? Th-Then, maybe I'll...
just a little bit... um, give it a try too.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Wingbeat of the fire dragon, breath of the Ifrit...
Answer my call and become my strength!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Yaaaa—h!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
W-What do you think of my flame magic...!
It was so flashy even I surprised myself, though.
choice_data_list: Whoa, now that's impressive, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes. Magic is wonderful precisely because
it's impossible in reality...!
choice_data_list: By the way, that outfit... haven't I seen it somewhere before?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"There were parts in the character creator
that looked similar...
Ehehe, I made it pretty well, if I do say so myself."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh...?
I can't... use magic?
choice_data_list: Looks like you can't use flashy attack magic in the middle of town.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... A city with restrictions on offensive magic
puts mages at way too much of a disadvantage...
choice_data_list: Why not try a melee frontline class too?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: "B-Because frontline jobs are meant for charging into enemy lines and fighting massive monsters head-on, right...?"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: It said they're usually the core pillar of the party in online co-op, so someone like me...
choice_data_list: "Your Very Own Heroic Tale!" You'd be missing out if you didn't enjoy it!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...My...
My very own heroic tale..."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: "...I-I'm still a bit scared, but... I'll try it—Melee Rob Roy!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Taah!

Afterward, along with Zenno Rob Roy who had
made her debut as a frontliner, we finished the tutorial—

I ended up going on an adventure with
various players in an online match.

text_block_list.name: Mage Player
text_block_list.text:
Kyaah, magic doesn't work on these guys!?
T-They're targeting me...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I-I'll take point...!
Please stay back, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Heavy Knight Player
text_block_list.text:
Guh... It's too fast, my attacks won't hit...!
With something like that around, we'll just get picked apart...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
S-Since my job is a fighter, maybe I can manage something...
Don't be scared... Don't be scared...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Hi-yah!

text_block_list.name: Cleric Player
text_block_list.text: You're super reliable~! Like, a total hero!? Let's hang out again sometime if fate allows~!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-san.
Did I really... look like a hero?
choice_data_list: You really pulled off being a true hero!
You were a real hero out there!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
F-Frontline class...
might actually be... kinda fun.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Heroic qualities... Heroic qualities... Hmmm.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"From your perspective, Trainer...
which one looked more like a hero: sword or martial arts?"
choice_data_list: A reliable sword hero who vanquishes evil head-on!
The martial arts hero who overwhelms enemies with versatile, ever-changing attacks!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
R-Reliable... e-ehehe...
Am I really... reliable?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"You're right, when I think of a 'hero,'
I definitely picture someone holding up a sword."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Continuing like this and aiming for an advanced class
might be a good idea too.
choice_data_list: Aim to become a Sword Saint, maybe!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Th-Then... if we ever get the chance again...
...would you like to hang out together?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I'll t-try to aim for a powerful hero...
that everyone can rely on!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Parrying enemy attacks like flowing water,
and sweeping across the battlefield with fiery strikes...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: A fighting style that takes away the breath of anyone watching... maybe that really is an element of a hero?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Dodging an attack by a hair's breadth and landing a massive finishing blow...
That might've actually been kind of fun.
choice_data_list: Watching you run freely across the battlefield was amazing!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um... the next time you come over to play...
would you like to continue where we left off together?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"I'll do my best to become
a cool hero everyone admires!"
